name: Cleanup After Door Frame Paint
intent: Final inspect cured door frames, touch up any final defects, tear down floor protection and wall masking, clean tools. Door frames are high-touch surfaces — final inspect gets extra scrutiny.
doctrine: Teardown rates cloned from trim paint cleanup (floor 500 SF/hr, wall mask 200 LF/hr). Final inspect slower than interstage inspect (25 vs 30 EA/hr) because final inspection is more rigorous — looking for runs, holidays, lap marks visible to the customer.
